curriculumMapping.outcomeCode: Use only when the source supports the exact question→outcome mapping.
curriculumMapping.candidateOutcomeCodes: Allowed when the source only supplies a theme-level outcome-code list.
curriculumMapping.default: No topic/skill/outcome is required. Never derive curriculum identifiers from question id.
curriculumMapping.explicit: topicId/skillId must exist in the selected canonical scope. outcomeCode/outcomeId must belong to the supplied topic/skill, or to the unit if no detail is given. Invalid explicit mapping is rejected.
curriculumMapping.runtimeGrouping: Public legacy topic/topicId fields use unitId as a grouping key when there is no detailed mapping. This does not assert a canonical skill relationship.

questionContract.content: Optional public plain text (1–10000 characters); line breaks are preserved. Never interpreted as HTML.

packageImage.src: Package-relative .png/.jpg/.jpeg/.webp path; existing file required. No URLs, absolute paths, traversal or symlinks.
packageImage.alt: Required readable description. Importer publishes only verified raster bytes and generates a controlled public visual DTO.

visual.alt: Describe given visible structure, never computed results or correctness. Human editorial accessibility review required.

controlledAssets.school: functions/visuals/school-life.mjs: closed School Life presets, fixed descriptive alt; school-dialogue additionally requires speech identical to the question stem

objects.scattered: Internal deterministic positions; no coordinates accepted

numberLine.jumps: Optional integer 1–10, cannot exceed displayed intervals

optionContract.text: Existing text is preserved. An empty string is allowed only with a valid visual.
optionContract.visual: Same contract as question.visual; question and option visuals can coexist.

questionContract.explanation: Optional private plain text; missing or blank becomes an empty explanation. Non-string values are rejected.

rules: Do not invent a precise outcome mapping when the source does not establish one.
Explicit topic/skill/outcome metadata must match the canonical curriculum; omission means unit/theme-level scope.
correctOptionId must reference an existing option id.
Student UI must not display curriculum codes.
Difficulty is pedagogical metadata, not an XP multiplier unless the app explicitly chooses that later.
Structured visuals only: no raw SVG/HTML, scripts, URLs or correctness fields in visual. Unknown kinds/shapes are rejected until a validated renderer is added.

sharedStimuli.resolution: import resolves to frozen validated visual; no shared XP or client answer key

bankContract.inheritance: Questions inherit unitId/topicId/skillId/outcomeCode/outcomeId from bank metadata. Conflicting explicit values are rejected. Legacy banks may omit bank.unitId when every question provides it (or use bank.unit.id).
bankContract.questions: 1–200 questions. Canonical grade + subject + unit/theme are always verified.
